name: St. Elias Mountains

geo.extent: South-western Yukon and north-western BC along the Alaska boundary

description: The highest mountains in Canada, in south-western Yukon and the far north-west of BC: two ranges separated by the Duke Depression, with the world's largest non-polar icefields in the Icefield Ranges. Kluane National Park and Reserve holds 17 of Canada's 20 tallest mountains, including Mount Logan (5,959 m); over half of the park is permanently covered in snow and ice.
